# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD decision files the content audit found missing.

dod_restore_the_rashidis = {
	is_shown = {
		c:ALH ?= this
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_arb_rashidi }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		owns_entire_state_region = STATE_HAIL
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_variable = dod_arb_rashidi
		add_modifier = { name = dod_arb_rashidi_restoration months = 120 }
		s:STATE_NEJD = { add_claim = root }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 50 }
}

dod_unite_arabia = {
	is_shown = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:bedouin
		NOT = { exists = c:UAR }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		owns_entire_state_region = STATE_NEJD
		owns_entire_state_region = STATE_HAIL
		owns_entire_state_region = STATE_YEMEN
	}
	when_taken = {
		change_tag = UAR
		add_modifier = { name = dod_arb_rashidi_restoration months = 120 }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 80 }
}
